versions.changelog:
Initial release of systematic QA testing and automated bug-fixing for web applications.

- Runs interactive QA tests (Quick, Standard, Exhaustive) and iteratively fixes bugs, committing each fix atomically.
- Outputs detailed reports with health scores, fix evidence (screenshots, repro steps), and ship-readiness summary.
- Supports diff-aware mode for feature branches and integrates authentication flows.
- Classifies and prioritizes bugs by severity; only fixes within configured tier.
- Provides clear protocols for incomplete/blocked/warning states.
